ComingSoon.title: {feature} — coming in a later phase
ComingSoon.body: This part of the platform is planned but not built yet. We are building the educational foundation first so that every feature rests on reviewed, traceable content.

Home.heroBody: Evidence-based, nursing-specific education for adult ICU nurses anywhere in the world: what to assess, what to monitor, what is abnormal, when to escalate and what to document.
Home.domainsIntro: A structured curriculum from airway and ventilation to professional practice, written for beginner, intermediate and advanced ICU nurses.
Home.how1Body: References show the organisation, guideline version and the date the source was last checked. Draft guidelines are always labelled as drafts.
Home.how2Title: Clinical review is recorded, not claimed
Home.how2Body: A topic is published only after named clinical reviewers approve a specific version. The database enforces this; AI-assisted drafts cannot approve themselves.
Home.how3Body: Actions are separated into assessment, monitoring, escalation, independent nursing care, and interventions that need an order or an approved local protocol.
Home.how4Body: International evidence, locale-aware content, right-to-left layouts and no automatic dose conversion. Local policy always takes precedence.
Home.roadmapBody: Clinical skills, a medication reference, patient simulations, examinations and a source-grounded AI assistant are planned for later phases.
Home.disclaimerBody: ICU Nurse Knowledge Map supports learning. It does not replace professional judgement, supervised competency validation or your institution's protocols. No accreditation or certification is claimed.
